ingles.titulo: The Beale Cipher Mystery: Lost Treasure in Virginia
ingles.descripcion: Did you know a treasure worth over $40 million is hidden in Virginia? In 1820, an adventurer left a box with three encrypted messages in Bedford County. The innkeeper passed it to a posadero in Lynchburg in 1822, who was to open it only if no one returned in ten years. In 1845, the posadero opened the box and found two letters and the three ciphers; only the second was cracked using the Declaration of Independence.
